strongest_angle: Examining Voya Financial's October 2026 inaugural America's Financial Confidence Index, which reveals a significant confidence gap where workplace education impacts financial mindset more than raw income.

key_facts.fact: Voya Financial, Inc. released the inaugural America's Financial Confidence Index on October 14, 2026, uncovering a confidence gap between employee feelings and actions.
Employee Benefit News reported on October 14, 2026, that 21 points separate worker confidence in retirement planning from another critical financial expectation.
Business Wire published on October 15, 2026, that the new Voya Index finds workplace education drives financial confidence and positive action more than money.
